description: Migrated from the v1 allowlist (window.print). The frontend (src/main.js) only calls our own #[tauri::command] functions via invoke() plus DOM window.print() — no Tauri window or dialog JS globals — so only core:default is needed. The PDF file picker is invoked from Rust (open_pdf via DialogExt), which is not gated by frontend capabilities; the tauri-plugin-dialog plugin still must be registered in main.rs.
